label: Physics & Quantum Phenomena
brief: Create five clean, futuristic physics vectors: a black hole geodesic, phase-space orbit, quantum wavepacket, magnetic dipole, and optical prism dispersion.

items.name: Black Hole Geodesic
items.description: Curved light geodesic bending around an event horizon silhouette.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a circular event horizon silhouette with light geodesics gravitationally lensing around it in glowing concentric arcs; strictly no text.

items.name: Phase Space Orbit
items.description: Elliptical state trajectory spiraling in 2D momentum-position phase space.
items.generation_prompt: Draw an elegant elliptical spiral phase-space trajectory with subtle directional arrows indicating state flow; no text or numbers.

items.name: Quantum Wavepacket
items.description: Gaussian wavepacket envelope modulating high-frequency probability oscillations.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a localized Gaussian wavepacket envelope modulating sinusoidal oscillations with a central amplitude peak; no text.

items.name: Magnetic Dipole Field
items.description: Toroidal magnetic dipole field lines looping symmetrically between dual poles.
items.generation_prompt: Draw symmetric toroidal dipole magnetic field lines looping smoothly around dual magnetic pole nodes; no text or letters.

items.name: Prism Dispersion
items.description: Geometric triangular prism refracting a light beam into divergent rays.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a minimal triangular glass prism with an incident ray refracting and fanning out into distinct divergent spectral rays; no text.
